description: This file defines an abstract class AuthorizationContextType used for representing and comparing authorization context types within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes validation, comparison, and equality logic based on a backing string 'type'.

classes.name: AuthorizationContextType
classes.description: An abstract class representing the type of an AuthorizationContext, specified by a non-null, non-empty string. Implements CharSequence and Comparable, providing methods for string manipulation and comparison based on the type.

methods.name: AuthorizationContextType
methods.description: Constructor initializing the type with a non-null, non-empty string.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index of the type string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the type string from start to end indices.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this AuthorizationContextType to another based on the string representation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the type string and class/interface conformance.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on the type string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the type.
